scope: Fourteen source-backed historical preconstructed/boxed/premium-deck Scryfall product records, with direct official Wizards articles or Wizards' Japanese product archive. Sources establish family/boxed releases without inferring modern card legality, complete printings or premier-set status.

records.source_section: Coldsnap Q&A — theme decks made for the July 21, 2006 release
Premium Deck Series: SLIVERS — 60-card foil deck, official three-letter code H09
Premium Deck Series: Fire & Lightning — official three-letter code PD2
Premium Deck Series: Graveborn — official three-letter code PD3
Modern Event Deck — 60-card Modern deck plus sideboard, official three-letter code MD1
Explorers of Ixalan — four preconstructed decks in board-game box
Guilds of Ravnica Guild Kits — five guild-themed preconstructed decks
Updated Core Set 2019 Gift Pack — boosters and exclusive foil creature cards
Magic Game Night — five monocolor preconstructed decks for multiplayer
Ravnica Allegiance Guild Kits — five preconstructed guild decks
Game Night 2019 Decklists — five preconstructed decks
Pioneer Challenger Decks 2021 — four 75-card tabletop deck products
Game Night: Free-for-All — five preconstructed decks, separately corrected printed insert

source_caveats: The single 2018 Wizards article has separate Game Night and Updated Gift Pack sections, supporting different gnt and g18 products without implying independent official set codes.
For Game Night: Free-for-All, Wizards separately corrected an erroneous Dark Sacrifice printed decklist insert; a web decklist is not an exact printing audit.
Japanese Wizards Premium Deck Series and Modern Event Deck product pages directly print the set code. These are stronger code evidence than normal named-family crosswalks.
The 2006 Coldsnap Q&A establishes the theme deck product family, not a direct printed CST code.
